name: read_local_file
description: Read a file's contents from the given path. Optionally read a byte range with offset/length, or prefix each returned line with its line number (line_numbers). No sandboxing.

offset.description: Byte offset to start reading from (default 0).

length.description: Max bytes to read (default and cap 1048576).

line_numbers.description: Prefix each returned line with its 1-based line number (default false).
